{{Quote|I served six years in Tempest Force, rising to sergeant. We were one of the finest legions in the New Order. Saw action at Kashyyyk, Marcelan Prime, Sarko, Aurimaus, and a lot of places you never heard of.|Hume Tarl, excerpt from interview with Cindel Towani included in ''Portraits of the Galactic Civil War''|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Aurimaus''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Aurimaus system/Legends|Aurimaus system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]] unit, which included<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Tarl}}</ref> [[Hume Tarl/Legends|Hume Tarl]], participated in a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] operation at Aurimaus.<ref name="EGTW" />

Later, when<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]]<ref name="Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref> [[Cindel Towani]] interviewed Tarl about the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the latter mentioned the operation at Aurimaus among other engagements the Tempest Force had been involved in. The interview was eventually included in Towani's [[41 ABY]] work ''[[Portraits of the Galactic Civil War]]''.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[Tarl has]'' served in battles that are a mix of existing locations and new ones, which ensures the galaxy feels big.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Blog">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>}}
Aurimaus was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Fry later noted in his personal blog that in the section of the book containing the interview with Hume Tarl, the locations that were new to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, such as Aurimaus, were introduced in order to make the ''Star Wars'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] seem an expansive setting.<ref name="Blog" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Aurimaus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square I-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
